rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP Remote macOS Server provides secure remote control of macOS machines through VNC protocol, enabling AI assistants to capture screenshots and interact with the remote desktop through mouse and keyboard inputs. The implementation supports Apple Authentication (protocol 30) for secure connections, handles screen scaling for consistent display, and includes comprehensive error handling for connection issues. Built with a focus on security and reliability, this server is ideal for remote administration, automated testing, or AI-powered interaction with macOS systems.
